title: Caller ID Testing Activation Guide
description: Step-by-step guide to enable Caller ID Testing on your device

steps.title: Select Caller ID Testing
steps.description: From the Unetwork Tasks screen, tap on 'Caller ID Testing' to view details and begin the activation process.

steps.title: Review How It Works
steps.description: Read through the process: 1) Opt in to participate, 2) Verify your phone number, 3) Receive test calls from our network, 4) You don't need to answer - missed calls count, 5) Report the Caller ID when prompted, 6) Earn rewards for each successful test. Then tap 'ACCEPT' to continue.

steps.title: Enter Your Phone Number
steps.description: Select your country code and enter your phone number to receive a verification code via SMS.

steps.title: Verify with OTP
steps.description: Enter the 6-digit verification code sent to your phone and tap 'VERIFY' to complete the setup. Test calls may come from various international numbers.
